bluf: Code and Theory is Stagwell's New York digital transformation agency, founded in 2001, built on a 50% creative, 50% engineer model and sold to the C suite. It is moving hard into AI and Adobe: agentic engineering and forward deployed teams, The One Show 2026 AI Pioneer in 2026-05, a record 16 ANA B2 awards in 2026-06 and the QStrauss Consulting acquisition for Adobe implementation in 2026-07. What a rival should know: 17 of its 20 named clients are names only, Microsoft, Marriott Bonvoy and Under Armour sit on other tracked books, and its delivery footprint in Bengaluru and Manila is observed, not inferred.
doing:
The positioning line reads: digital transformation agency built on a 50% creative, 50% engineer model, joining brand, product, technology and marketing for C suite transformation. In plain words, an engineering led build shop selling to the C suite, not to a media buyer. The headline claim, that the 50/50 model has earned the trust of more than 50 Fortune 500 CEOs, CMOs and CTOs, is not itemised in the record.

Service lines run from Brand, Product, Technology and Marketing through Customer Experience and AI Enabled Business Transformation to Adobe Experience Cloud implementation and Agentic engineering; proprietary are the Forward Deployed Expertise (FD/x) model, an agentic engineering process with AI accelerators and the DECODE newsletter; Adobe is the one partner. It leads with Web & Product, scored 3: the homepage H1 sells digital transformation and the builds include NFL.com, the NFL and Flyers apps and the Henry Schein ecommerce platform. Core lines scored 2 are AI Automation / Agents (agentic engineering teams, the TIME AI overhaul case) and B2B & ABM (the Amazon Business and Microsoft cases). AI search, content, data and email score 1; SEO, paid search, paid social, programmatic, retail media, CRO, creator and local score 0.

Its AI posture is agentic engineering and vibe coded prototyping, AI accelerators and forward deployed teams, with AI and AEO powered commerce work for JBL: AI sold as engineering capacity, not marketing.

The moves run: 2025-11 a major player in two 2025 IDC MarketScapes; 2025-12 Adweek's inaugural Innovation Agency of the Year; 2026-04 a new president to help CMOs with AI complexity; 2026-05 The One Show AI Pioneer; 2026-06 the 16 ANA B2 awards and Stagwell hired by IBM as lead creative partner; 2026-07 Stagwell agreed to buy QStrauss Consulting for the Adobe practice. No pricing signal is listed. Absent for a company of 800 to 1,000 people: any paid media, SEO or measurement line, case study text, news items and jobs.

openings:
The strongest opening is the observed offshore footprint: Bengaluru and Manila are listed offices, the Monsoon read puts migration at 75.6 with Web & Product carrying 24 of the movable hours, and the record holds no onshore claim. An onshore delivery pitch to its financial services and media accounts has something concrete to point at, likely to land, moderate confidence. Second, the book is thin on evidence: 17 of 20 clients are names only, so what it does for TIME, NFL or JPMorganChase is a question to ask them, and Microsoft, Marriott Bonvoy and Under Armour already shop across instrument, razorfish, merkle and others, contestable at roughly even chance each. Third, P2 is absent: no feed, schema or entity work despite JBL AEO commerce and the Henry Schein platform, unclaimed ground on a build shop that could own it. Fifth, the media gap: SEO, paid search, paid social and measurement all score 0, so any account needing demand after the build is very likely, high confidence, to buy it elsewhere.
